package.name: Upload
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Upload an explicitly selected file after destination approval, to an account's destination or anonymously.

exports.description: Explicit file selection and cloud-upload consent; file bytes and credentials stay in the trusted platform host.

choose.description: Upload the file already selected on Send after destination approval.

choose_anonymous.description: Upload the file already selected on Send to Catbox, which needs no account and no key, after approval of that address and of the address its public link lives on.

configure.description: Manage the encrypted API key for this destination without selecting or uploading a file.

status.description: Answers what a person did on this extension's settings line with the line as it is after it: whether an API key is saved, whether the provider accepts it, and what the destination that needs no key does.

settings.label: Upload destination
settings.help: Choose which destination is offered for selected files on Send. poo.wang needs a usable API key; Catbox never uses one.

pages.title: What this extension does
pages.explains: Upload sends the name and contents of one selected file only after you approve the destination. poo.wang receives it at https://poo.wang/api/upload or in parts at https://poo.wang/api/upload/session/part. Only poo.wang receives your saved key, for checks at https://poo.wang/api/me and for the upload or session creation. Catbox receives the file at https://catbox.moe/user/api.php without a key or account. The extension never receives the file contents or saved key.
pages.changes: Choose on Send offers both destinations when a usable poo.wang key is saved. Selecting only Catbox never looks up a key; an unreadable destination stops uploads and key operations. Catbox needs an identified HTTPS client, takes up to 6 MiB here, and returns a public link on https://files.catbox.moe. poo.wang uses a saved key here and uploads expire after 24 hours. Missing prerequisites or disallowed file sizes are unavailable, not permission denials. Cancelling stops remaining key checks; it does not undo a completed save or upload.
